capabilities.text: Copy progress note from Meditech to CareTrack
capabilities.quote: she copied the same note into the hospital’s internal ward management system, called CareTrack

capabilities.text: Connect Meditech and CareTrack systems
capabilities.quote: So we’ll focus only on connecting those two.

capabilities.text: Specification written in plain language for a coding agent
capabilities.quote: the specification should be written in plain language that a coding agent can follow

capabilities.text: Tool simple enough for minimal tech experience users
capabilities.quote: I’ll make sure the tool is simple enough that even someone with minimal tech experience can use it.

capabilities.text: Built using C#, .NET, and SQL Server
capabilities.quote: So we’ll specify the solution to be built using C#, .NET, and SQL Server

capabilities.text: Code managed in Azure DevOps
capabilities.quote: with all code managed in Azure DevOps

capabilities.text: Deployment to on-prem servers
capabilities.quote: and that the team will handle deployment to our on-prem servers.

capabilities.text: Version one live by October 15
capabilities.quote: We need version one live on Ward 4B by October 15

capabilities.text: Nurse confirms note before sending to CareTrack
capabilities.quote: Got it: the nurse reviews and confirms each note before it goes into CareTrack.

capabilities.text: Budget of £45,000 for the full project
capabilities.quote: We have a budget of £45,000 for the full project

capabilities.text: Build in-house with external team
capabilities.quote: We’ll build it in-house with our external team.

capabilities.text: Add 'Send to CareTrack' button in Meditech toolbar
capabilities.quote: clicks a new “Send to CareTrack” button that appears in the bottom toolbar.

capabilities.text: Confirm note send with pop-up preview
capabilities.quote: A pop-up appears asking: “Send this note to CareTrack?” with the exact text of the note previewed.

capabilities.text: Note appears in CareTrack with current time stamp
capabilities.quote: The note then appears in CareTrack under the same patient’s record, timestamped with the current time

capabilities.text: Flag sent note in red for 30 seconds in CareTrack
capabilities.quote: and is flagged in red for 30 seconds to show it was auto-synced

capabilities.text: Handle send failures with error message and retry option
capabilities.quote: If a note fails to send, the nurse should see a clear error message on screen: “Failed to send to CareTrack — check connection and try again.”

capabilities.text: Note remains in Meditech if send fails
capabilities.quote: The note remains in Meditech and is not lost; the nurse can retry immediately or later.

capabilities.text: Log send failures and alert IT helpdesk after three consecutive failures
capabilities.quote: If it fails three times in a row, the system logs the error automatically and sends an alert to the IT helpdesk.

capabilities.text: Patient data stays within on-prem servers
capabilities.quote: All patient data must stay within our on-prem servers, never leave the hospital network

capabilities.text: Encrypt patient data at rest and in transit
capabilities.quote: and be encrypted at rest and in transit.

capabilities.text: Log every send attempt with user, time, and outcome
capabilities.quote: The tool must log every send attempt, including who sent it, when, and whether it succeeded

capabilities.text: Keep send logs for 12 months
capabilities.quote: and those logs must be kept for 12 months.

capabilities.text: Single user role: 'Ward Nurse/Assistant'
capabilities.quote: Just one role: “Ward Nurse/Assistant.”

capabilities.text: Users can only view and send their own notes
capabilities.quote: they can only view and send their own notes, and only to CareTrack.

capabilities.text: Check last progress note in Meditech before writing new one
capabilities.quote: The first thing they do is check the last progress note in Meditech to see how the patient was doing at the end of the previous shift
